observed_problems: The frozen entry is the next one-minute open after source availability, but prior_15m_return, prior_60m_realized_volatility, prior_60m_path_efficiency and cross-asset breadth were read at that entry-minute index. Those arrays include the entry minute close and therefore one minute of unavailable future information.

When neither frozen liquidity target nor structural stop was reached before an internal partition boundary, the account code assigned the stop price at the boundary. That created a clock-driven synthetic stop and violated the no-elapsed-time-liquidation contract.

The executable code still used confirmation AUC, Brier skill, median, PF, breadth and winner-removal diagnostics as pre-2024 advancement vetoes despite AMENDMENT-20260726-ML-STABLECOIN-IMMEDIATE-2024H1-AFTER-COST-POSSIBILITY-004 explicitly making them reported diagnostics rather than opening gates.
changes: Read all completed return, volatility, efficiency and breadth features from entry_index minus one while keeping the frozen prior-liquidity levels evaluated at the entry open.

When a structural path remains unresolved at a partition boundary, mark the open position at the last completed close with hypothetical exit cost for NAV valuation; do not assign the stop price and do not call it a strategy exit.
Open calendar-2023 development after a successful causal model fit regardless of confirmation diagnostic signs.

Advance to the frozen risk/notional search and immediate 2024H1 handoff when calendar-2023 total return is positive at 24bp and no liquidation or bankruptcy occurs. Winner removal and all other diagnostics remain reported but are not pre-2024 vetoes.
Align the risk and notional grids exactly with amendment 004 and select the highest-growth positive no-liquidation 24bp path without a growth ceiling.
